run.back: yardr user device pair --end ends it while it stands; once the code is used, yardr user device rm ada tablet removes the device
run.command: yardr user device pair ada tablet --url https://mac.example.net
run.description: Enrol a device by a short code, or a QR code, with no token to copy
does: opens a pairing for the device tablet of ada, reached at https://mac.example.net.
Approval opens the pairing for that device alone: its code is good for ten minutes and for one device, and whoever has the code within those minutes is answered with that device's token.
Nothing in the yard keeps the code after it is used or runs out.
The new device then calls as ada until yardr user device rm ada tablet, and ada will then have 2 devices.

weight.line: widens who the yard listens to: a new device tablet of ada speaks as them: whoever holds its token calls as ada until the device is removed
